description: What does a household's yearly electricity and gas cost in an EU country, and how many hours of work pay for it?. Eurostat household electricity and gas prices (all taxes) with Europe rank and history, turned into an annual bill for your consumption and into hours of average paid work (ILOSTAT hourly earnings). Computed by Lilambd. Routes: /answer (country*, kwh, gj, limit); /countries (limit). Paid $0.5 USDC per call via x402 (_meta["x402/payment"]); set sample=true for a free 3-row preview.

route.description: One of: /answer, /countries. Replace {placeholders} with a value, e.g. /search or /HND.

name: energy-bill-hours
